Student Dies by Suicide in Hostel; Police Cite Academic Stress

An 18-year-old student died by suicide in a hostel room in Kankipadu. Police stated that a handwritten note found at the scene indicated academic stress as the cause. The incident occurred at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) in Bengaluru.
